Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Stable weight (variation of less than 5 kg within 3 months prior to screening visit) - BMI (Body Mass Index) of 30 or greater in patients with or without comorbidities, or BMI greater than 27 in patients with treated or untreated hypertension and/or treated or untreated dyslipidemia
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's weight stability and BMI are not provided in the patient data, making it impossible to determine if the criterion is met.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Stable weight (variation of less than 5 kg within 3 months prior to screening visit) - BMI (Body Mass Index) of 30 or greater in patients with or without comorbidities, or BMI greater than 27 in patients with treated or untreated hypertension and/or treated or untreated dyslipidemia
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: This criterion is an inclusion criterion, not an exclusion criterion, and thus does not apply in the context of exclusion criteria assessment.
